primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model - Feature engineering: EWMA of workload features with **span 6**; ACWR with 6-day acute / 27-day chronic windows; monotony over seven days; prior-injury EWMA.

primitives.breakdown_regime: When workload features are sparse or non-stationary, EWMA may lag behind sudden changes.

primitives.assumptions: Workload imbalance increases injury risk; chronic load reflects adaptation capacity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When chronic workload is near zero, ACWR becomes undefined or extremely large.

primitives.verbatim_quote: - Monotony = weekly mean / weekly standard deviation over seven days.
